text: 疲惫终于压倒了你。你向后靠去，闭上眼睛，沉沉睡着了。
奇怪而可怕的梦扰乱了你的睡眠。你看见一座由大理石、缟玛瑙和璀璨宝石构成的辉煌城市。这座宏伟城市尽显壮丽，坐落在平静的湖畔。随后转瞬之间，水位上涨，将它吞没，城市消失无踪。偶像中的蜥蜴状怪物获得生命与力量后，从水中猛然升起。水势膨胀，将你吞噬，那存在以充满恶意的灵智注视着你。
你仿佛在这种状态中度过了永恒，和那可怕的蜥蜴状怪物一起漂浮在沉没的废墟间。它紧盯着你，审视着你的一举一动。但它始终没有行动，只是克制着恶意注视你。你凝视它的双眼，开始希望它干脆吞掉你，这样你就不必再受它监视。这种渴望变得令人发狂，你发现自己竟自愿朝那东西游去。它张开大口迎接你，露出一排又一排针尖般的牙齿。就在你即将把自己献给那怪物之际，你终于醒了过来。
你发现自己悬在钟楼边缘，差点滚进下方被洪水淹没的小镇，沉入水中。你赶紧退回平台中央以确保安全。你回头望向平静的洪水湖面，注意到一小队船只在废墟间漂浮，正在寻找幸存者。你连忙朝他们呼喊，不久便有人把你扶上船。
船把你带到岸边时，当局向你询问这里发生了什么。你尽可能解释自己所知的一切——至少说了那些听起来可信的部分。你一上岸就被迅速送往波士顿休养。接下来几天里，你又与当局交谈了几次，得知自己是这起事件唯一的幸存者。你庆幸自己活着逃了出来，但这里发生的一切将永远困扰着你。
恭喜你在《潮汐独行》的恐怖事件中幸存。你可以保存这个角色，今后在其他《克苏鲁的呼唤》游戏中继续使用；不过，由于这场冒险中发生的可怕事件，你损失 1D6 点理智。你在埃斯伯里的旅程结束。结局。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 220
text: Exhaustion overtakes you. You lean back, close your eyes, and drift into a deep slumber.

Your sleep is disturbed by strange and horrific dreams. You see a shining city of marble, onyx, and lustrous gems. You see this magnificent city in all its splendor, sitting next to a placid lake. And then, in an instant, it’s gone as the water rises up to swallow it. The lizard-thing of the idol, given life and power, surges up from the water. The being eyes you with malicious sentience as the waters swell and consume you.

You exist in this state for what feels like an eternity, drifting through the sunken ruins alongside the horrible lizard-thing. It eyes you closely, scrutinizing your every motion. But it never acts, merely watches you with checked malevolence. As you stare into its eyes, you begin to wish it would simply consume you so you wouldn’t have to be under its watchful gaze any longer. This becomes a maddening desire, and you find yourself willingly swimming toward the thing. It opens its jaws to receive you, revealing row after row of needle-like teeth. Just as you’re about to offer yourself to the creature, you finally wake.

You find yourself dangling over the edge of the belfry, about to roll into the flooded town below and lose yourself in the waters. You quickly pull back toward the center of the platform for safety. Glancing back at the peaceful, flooded lake, you notice a small group of boats floating amid the ruins, searching for survivors. You quickly call out to them, and it isn’t long before you’re helped into a boat.

As you’re taken to shore, the authorities question you about what happened here. You explain what you can—the believable bits, at least. Once you make land, you’re quickly taken to Boston to recover. Over the next few days, you confer with the authorities a few more times and find that you’re the incident’s only survivor. You’re relieved to have escaped with your life, but the memory of what happened there will haunt you forever. Congratulations, you have survived the horrific events of Alone Against the Tide. You may save this character for future use in another Call of Cthulhu game, though you do lose 1D6 Sanity points as a result of the terrible things that occurred during this adventure. Your visit to Esbury is over.
